basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified to shortlisted candidates

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 35 Years. Age relaxation is applicable as per project rules if any.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow: B.E./B.Tech (with NET/GATE qualification) or M.E./M.Tech (with GATE qualification) in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant disciplines. Candidates with prior research experience and knowledge related to additive manufacturing, microscopy, mechanical testing etc. will be preferred.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on merit and project requirements
followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.
how_to_apply: Compile your self-attested marksheets and degree certificates into a single PDF file.
Compose an email addressed to the Principal Investigator ([email protected]).
Set the subject of the email exactly as: "Application for JRF position in project No. SRDP 1332 G".
Attach the single PDF containing your CV, marksheets, and degree certificates to the email.
Send the email on or before 20/10/2026.
important_instructions: Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. All candidates must make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The selected candidate may be allowed to enroll in the PhD program if the required criteria for PhD admission at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is fulfilled.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad has announced recruitment for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under an ANRF-ECRG sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 20/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech with NET/GATE qualification or M.E./M.Tech with GATE qualification in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship amount for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of INR 37,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their CV along with self-attested marksheets and degree certificates as a single PDF to the PI by email at [email protected], mentioning the project number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted individuals will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected candidate enroll in a PhD program?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate may be allowed to enroll in the PhD program if the required criteria for PhD admission at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is fulfilled.
